original: My first debate round lasted four minutes before I forgot my entire argument and just stood there.
polished: My very first debate round concluded after a mere four minutes when I forgot my entire argument and stood frozen before the judge.

original: The judge actually put her pen down.
polished: It is important to note that the judge visibly set down her pen in disappointment.

original: I wanted to quit that night, but my partner texted me a single word: 'again.'
polished: I wanted desperately to quit that very night, but my partner sent a single, powerful word: 'again.'

original: So we drilled rebuttals in her basement every Tuesday for a month.

original: I lost my next six rounds too, honestly, but by the regional tournament I could feel the argument forming while the other team was still talking.
